attributes.comment: True where the pixel images an incident angle <= 90 degrees from the optical axis, i.e. within the fisheye's frontal hemisphere. False means the pixel is beyond the 90-degree hemisphere or not imaged at all (the dark corners of the bounding-box crop); a False pixel is discarded regardless of its count. Depends on the intrinsic calibration but kept in this raw store because it defines the crop that shrinks the stored data; treated as fixed per deployment, so a recalibration that changes it means a new dataset. Static per camera, computed at first write by squishing the single-channel mask into the four Bayer channels.
